correctedState: Confirmed as written. Two additions worth carrying. (a) The effective PRODUCTION value is 1, not merely the constant: SessionManager.ts:4152-4164 is the only orchestrator seed and never sets `depth`, so DEFAULT_MAX_DEPTH wins on every session; spawner.test.ts:536-553 proves the grandchild refusal and, as a positive control, that maxDepth 2 admits it. (b) The gap is two-part — the default is 1 against Claude's 3, AND there is no configurable override at all (no CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH reader and no NESSY_ equivalent anywhere in packages/, apps/ or scripts/), so a host can raise nesting only by supplying `orchestrator.depth` in the execution manifest, which no production path does. Note the deviation's shape at the limit: we return `Subagent depth limit exceeded (N)` from the call, which matches the page's FORK behaviour but not the named-subagent behaviour ('withholds the Agent tool'); spawner.ts:514-517 records that knowingly. The closure at 2026-07-26-r-queue-doc-verification.md:555 and :559 is stale and should be reopened. Same underlying gap as f076 (agent-sdk/subagents), f084 (sub-agents) and f164 (env-vars) — one fix closes all four; this changelog row is the version-history evidence for the other three, not an independent defect.
